**Allowed origins** (CORS, `worker/src/index.ts`, the `app.use('*', cors({ origin: ... }))` call, lines ~20–30):
- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain (`origin.endsWith('.pages.dev')`)
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain (`origin.endsWith('.workers.dev')`)

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add another exact-match check (e.g. `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'`) or an `.endsWith()` check for a wildcard subdomain, inside the existing `if (...)` block (same place as the current three conditions). Hono's `cors()` only matches array entries as exact strings, so wildcard subdomains must stay in this function form. Reference: `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)`.
